# Captured DOM fixtures

`chatgpt-power-complete.html` and `chatgpt-codemirror-reply-2026-10-11.html` are public HTML fixtures from [miuuyy/codex-chatgpt-web](https://github.com/miuuyy/codex-chatgpt-web), pinned to commit `0b6087c5307c7a58adda9c420358f3f70d2035f5` (MIT; `codex-chatgpt-web-LICENSE`).

Tests substitute synthetic request IDs, prompts and replies. The collapsed-message button variation models the reported Korean Work UI. These are offline captured-DOM tests, not a claim of a successful run on the owner's Galaxy or a live authenticated ChatGPT session.
